stories.title: （乡村行·看振兴）福建尤溪4.1万亩杂交水稻制种迎丰收 全链条机械化助农增收

en.title: Fujian's Youxi County Hybrid Rice Seed Production Achieves Bumper Harvest with Full-Chain Mechanization
en.summary: Youxi County in Fujian Province, a national-level seed production hub, is harvesting 41,000 acres of hybrid rice seeds with mechanized equipment handling collection, threshing, and cleaning in one pass. Seven seed drying centers operate at full capacity to ensure proper storage and preservation of the seeds.

en.title: Tianjin's National Day Holiday Consumption Releases Economic Vitality with 454 Enterprises Achieving 2.66 Billion Yuan in Sales
en.summary: During China's National Day holiday, 454 monitored commercial enterprises in Tianjin generated 2.66 billion yuan in sales, up 1.9% year-over-year, while foot traffic reached 18.4 million visits, representing a 3.1% increase.

en.title: How Puma fits into Chinese sportswear maker Anta's plan to challenge global rivals
en.summary: Anta Sports acquired a 29.06 percent stake in Puma for €1.51 billion, becoming the German sportswear brand's largest shareholder and strengthening its global competition against Nike and Adidas.

stories.title: ByteDance heads first SCMP Plus Going Global 100 ranking

en.title: ByteDance heads first SCMP Plus Going Global 100 ranking
en.summary: ByteDance ranks first in a new SCMP Plus Going Global 100 ranking that assesses mainland Chinese companies' overseas expansion efforts. The ranking evaluated over 2,000 companies and ranked ByteDance ahead of Foxconn, Shein, and BYD.

stories.title: More global investors eye Chinese equities, ending 4-year underweight run, bank says

en.title: More global investors eye Chinese equities, ending 4-year underweight run, bank says
en.summary: Global investors have increased their allocation to Chinese equities from underweight to benchmark-neutral positioning since June, driven by attractive valuations and artificial intelligence opportunities. This shift ends years of reduced investment but does not signal strong bullish sentiment.
